name: @onegrid/test
description: Adopter test harness for oneGrid — a recording Canvas-2D stub that lifts jsdom's hardest limit, query helpers over the grid's accessibility shadow, timeout-bounded async waits with diagnostic failures, deterministic row/data-source fakes with a controllable pending queue, user-event helpers that replay the exact sequences @onegrid/core listens for, and vitest matchers. Mount a real Grid in jsdom and assert what a user would see.
